build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with seed range and search params
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object in the PHYRE scene with a given scale and center position
add_static_bars: add static bar objects to the PHYRE scene with configurable scale, angle, and position
update_task_relationships: update the PHYRE task to require two bodies to be touching using SpatialRelationship
set_solution_tier: set the PHYRE task metadata to specify the TWO_BALLS solution tier
